claims.text: The method using $ eta$-entmax and $1.5$-entmax achieves 75% and 90% of the training speed of the standard softmax model, respectively.
The method with learned $ eta$ values shows a combination of sparse and dense attention, suggesting improved performance over fixed sparse Transformers.
